newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 472/473 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 472/473 per dollar.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed unchanged at 472.00/473.00 per dollar Monday as higher interest rates continued to keep pressure off the local currency, traders said.
Trading was quiet with a balance of buyers and sellers and some participation by the Central Bank, traders said.
There was little prospect of a sharp move in the exchange rate in coming weeks, they added.
"I don't see any reason for a devaluation in the short or medium term," one said.
